name: @slopmax/bench
description: The bench rig: mock provider, request bodies, oha runs, the demo home, and the CI performance gates

//.effect: Every bench step is an Effect: the processes under test are scoped child processes, the figures are Schema classes written as JSON, and the commands are effect/cli.
//.@effect/platform-bun: Bun's file system, paths and processes under the bench's commands (BunServices, BunRuntime.runMain).
//.@slopmax/core: The rig is the real daemon (Daemon, CoreBase's services) over a bench home with origins rewritten to the mock; the demo seeds state.json and the ledger with the engine's own Schemas.
//.@slopmax/domain: Settings, ledger records, windows and usage the rig and the demo write.
//.@slopmax/test: TestHome: each process under test gets a throwaway home under the OS temp directory, removed with its scope.
//.slopmax: The CLI's build script (`slopmax/build`): the bench builds the CLI with it (AOT and the fallback) and compiles the rig and the raw probe with exactly its AOT flags (aotArgs), so all three compare like with like.
//.bench: `mise run bench`: the DIST-012 table against the AOT binary `mise run compile` just built.
//.gates: `mise run gates`: ARCHITECTURE.md §16's budgets on the AOT binary `mise run compile` just built; the fallback, the rig and the raw probe are built here. Measured 2026-11-01 on linux-x64 (8 vCPU shared, load 7-12) with 1.4.4-canary.1+da867c60b: binary 71.4 MB (ok), 23.9 MB as xz (ok), --version 12.5 ms (ok), serve to /healthz 91-126 ms (budget 60), idle 57.6-58.3 MB (45), peak 155.6-157.0 MB (120), small 32 at once 9.1% of the raw probe (595 vs 6553 req/s; budget 70%), 300 KB 32 at once 14.5% (374 vs 2579 req/s; 80%), one-at-a-time p50 1.7 ms over the probe (0.15 ms). The fallback: 149.4 MB, 53.4 MB as xz, --version 20.1 ms, serve 248 ms, idle 64.0 MB. After the speed work (docs/parity/NOT-PORTED.md, "Speed"), the same day at load about 2: small 32 at once 27.4% of the probe (2,540 vs 9,282 req/s), 300 KB 32 at once 46.4% (1,510 vs 3,254), one-at-a-time p50 0.37 ms over the probe; idle 58.4 MB and peak 154.4 MB as before.
